entries.title: Gameplay, music & structure
lines: Safer sprite effects and repaired boss exits.
Separate level/boss music in optional packs.
Save deletion keeps menu music playing.

entries.title: Soundpack death screens
lines: Kamilia red fade; WannaFest VHS and red cubes.
Only pack death audio; R restores game sounds.
Animated blood; no bouncing Game Over.

entries.title: Graphics tools & stability
lines: Ctrl+Alt+D: independent graphics test switches.
Reports include a game screenshot and graphics.
Safer backgrounds, rewards and save transitions.

entries.title: Complete background sets
lines: Nine reviewed worlds now swap matching skies, clouds and parallax layers together.
World 3 clouds retain their original perspective, with no visible trapezoid edges.
Collision geometry stays original; incompatible scrolling combinations are excluded.
Background sets reload when switching saves or returning to the menu.

entries.title: Seamless saves and ending fixes
lines: Create, delete and switch compatible saves without restarting the game.
Each run reloads its own character profile, rewards and hack settings.
F2 closes the victory screen without reopening it over the next intro.
Kracko now gets four seconds for his defeat animation.

entries.title: Rush modes and clearer goals
lines: Boss Rush and Level Rush: choose your pool and count; Solgryn is the finale.
Tutorial removed from new randomizer routes.
Target Select goals are grouped and highlighted in the tracker.
Fixed a tracker connection error when reloading the same save.
Kracko now keeps four seconds for his death animation, including existing runs.

entries.title: Sprite chaos: materials and colors
lines: Separate background, decoration, floor and enemy color options. Original silhouettes, collision geometry, action points and animation timing are preserved.
Additional scenery and optional background dimming. Enemy colors are a reviewed beta subset, not full character replacements.
BR11 share codes include every visual option. Existing saved runs retain their original rules.

entries.title: Scenery shuffle beta
lines: Optional seeded scenery shuffle in Advanced > Hacks. Reviewed backgrounds and decoration change; enemies, hazards and collision geometry stay original.
Scenery stays consistent after death and reload. New BR10 share codes include the scenery option.

entries.title: Spider surprise
lines: Attacks enter from random positions along all four screen edges.
The spider turns its feet toward Boshy and flies 25% faster.
The existing attack interval and your on/off preference stay unchanged.

entries.title: Menu comfort and stability
lines: Fixed direct save-slot selection without closing the game.
Menus adapt to smaller windows; choose your text size with Aa.

entries.title: Normal mode
lines: Play the original progression with original chest rewards.
Choose a starting character and optional hacks.
Separate saves, shared settings and the run tracker remain available.
Normal mode now supports optional character changes between levels and boss rooms.

entries.title: Kappa reward room
lines: Defeat Kappa, then collect his reward.
His stage ends at the Teleport Room portal.
The correction also applies to saved runs.

entries.title: A better finish
lines: New victory screen with the Randomizer logo.
Translucent stats; the ending and credits keep playing.
Appears five seconds later.
Copy your full seed with one click.

entries.title: Recent improvements
lines: Kappa is now a separate boss after Justin.tv.
Refined Cheetahman, Kid Icarus and Desert starts.
Reliable shot changes, music loops and spider sprites.
Fresh seeds for new runs and safer same-room transitions.

entries.title: Recent improvements
lines: Rare spider surprise: optional, enabled for new runs.
Random attacks every 5–30 gameplay minutes, including bosses.
Music information in the tracker and faster state reads.

entries.title: Music shuffle and direct exits
lines: Optional shared music pool: 45 level and boss tracks.
Music choices travel with the seed; default is OFF.
Direct room exits keep arrival and reset protection.

entries.title: Recent improvements
lines: Animated intro scenery and clearer menu text.
Mouse and keyboard menus in five languages.
Safer settings, resets, stage splits and debug reports.

entries.title: Randomized native intro
lines: Gentle clouds, stars and desert dust behind the menu.
Theme-aware shading keeps text readable and steady.
Original platform shapes, timing and seeds stay intact.

entries.title: Menu navigation and shot-style controls
lines: Hover highlights choices; arrows move without changing settings.
Confirm with Enter or click. Tab, Shift+Tab and page keys navigate.
Choose timed, spot, death or combined shot-style changes directly.

entries.title: Stability and diagnostic reports
lines: Protected transitions with automatic pause release.
Automatic error reports and per-spot test evidence.
Completed saves open their run results directly.

entries.title: Random World in two parts
lines: Choose both sections separately in Advanced.
Crossing into part 2 now completes part 1.
Arrival and reset protection; existing seeds keep their rules.

entries.title: Kid Icarus and safer resets
lines: Kid Icarus: approach, miniboss and final section.
Boss completion waits for every fragment and the open exit.
Reset-time memory reads retry safely; existing runs keep their rules.

entries.title: Five UI languages
lines: Automatic language detection.
English, German, Russian, Spanish and Japanese.
Shared seeds keep the same rules.

entries.title: Your rules, your pace
lines: Choose shot timers in minutes and seconds.
Standard, Chaos and Training presets.
Active extras in the live tracker.

entries.title: Runs you can inspect
lines: Rule snapshots protect existing runs.
Run results and seed replay.
Debug reports explain transitions.

entries.title: Shot styles and comfort
lines: Random shot changes by time, death or spot.
Optional shorter chest animations.
Pop-ups and mouse ghost disabled by default.

entries.title: Native randomizer
lines: Legacy pixel randomizer retired.
Shared seeds include every extra.
Existing runs keep their own rules.

entries.title: Clearer menus
lines: Save details next to the slot numbers.
Updates in the original message window.
Online entry removed from the menu.

entries.title: Minibosses and transitions
lines: Kracko, Ryu passage and Gravitron added.
Position checks without screen pixels.
Ridley and Questionmark intro protection.
